name: Dawnwatcher Shaedlass
summary: In Darnassus, Dawnwatcher Shaedlass keeps watch for the Argent Dawn across Kalimdor. From the Craftsmen's Terrace, he seeks word of his fellow order members sent to scout hostile lands.

sections.title: Eyes of the Argent Dawn
sections.body: The Argent Dawn fights the Scourge in the Eastern Plaguelands, yet its watch reaches beyond Lordaeron. Dawnwatcher Shaedlass keeps the order's interests in Kalimdor from the night elf capital of Darnassus. At his post on the Craftsmen's Terrace, he follows covert expeditions against dark cults and corrupting powers that threaten the wider world.

sections.title: A Missing Brother
sections.body: Argent Guard Thaelrid is missing after a journey south to investigate cult activity in Blackfathom Deeps, along the Ashenvale coast. Shaedlass fears the Twilight's Hammer and the ancient elven temple's aquatic horrors may have harmed his comrade. He calls on daring Alliance adventurers to enter the ruins and learn what became of the scout.

faq.answer: Dawnwatcher Shaedlass is a night elf agent of the Argent Dawn, posted on the Craftsmen's Terrace in Darnassus. He connects the order with its efforts in northern Kalimdor.

faq.q: Why is an Argent Dawn member in Darnassus?
aliases: why is argent dawn in darnassus
faq.answer: The Argent Dawn fights the Scourge in Lordaeron, and keeps watch across Azeroth for corrupting evils. In Kalimdor, Shaedlass tracks threats such as shadowy cults.

faq.q: What does Shaedlass ask adventurers to do?
faq.answer: Shaedlass sends Alliance adventurers into the sunken temple of Blackfathom Deeps to find Argent Guard Thaelrid. Thaelrid went undercover to investigate the Twilight's Hammer and has not reported back.

faq.q: Where can I find Dawnwatcher Shaedlass?
faq.answer: Dawnwatcher Shaedlass is on the Craftsmen's Terrace in Darnassus, near the capital's trade vendors and craftsmen.

angles.text: For Alliance heroes in Darnassus, Shaedlass offers a path into the mysteries of Blackfathom Deeps and sends scouts to recover an operative deep behind enemy lines.
As a night elf serving openly with the Argent Dawn, Shaedlass links Teldrassil's insular politics with the order's watch against darkness across the world.
